links.outcome: Per-stratum conformal coverage and abstention rate, frozen reference calibration versus local re-split
links.effect: Frozen reference held all six strata within band (0.864-0.903) at abstention 0.113; local re-split under-covered to 0.71 at abstention 0.227; coverage survived survey weighting.
links.quote: Estimating the conformal quantile once on the deep frozen reference held all six strata within band (0.864-0.903) at abstention 0.113, whereas a local re-split - calibrating each stratum on far fewer rows - under-covered to 0.71 at abstention 0.227; the difference is a calibration-depth effect, and coverage survived survey weighting.

links.outcome: Subgroup coverage and calibration in transfer tests on held-out data
links.effect: Strata held coverage in the frozen configuration, but two transfer tests returned negatives; ocular transfer did not hold coverage at thin-n.
links.quote: Two transfer tests returned negatives; the ocular transfer did not hold coverage at thin-n.

links.outcome: Interface conformance to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility criteria
links.effect: WCAG 2.2 AA text criteria passed; interface requirements moved from 14/27/18 to 38/14/7 (MET/PARTIAL/UNMET).
links.quote: Interface requirements moved from 14/27/18 to 38/14/7 (MET/PARTIAL/UNMET); Nielsen severity resolved 7 of 10 issues; WCAG 2.2 AA text criteria passed.
